title: Let's use video to reinvent education | Salman Khan
summary: Salman Khan explains why he created Khan Academy, a structured library of video lessons with interactive exercises. He calls on teachers to flip the classroom, with lectures watched at home and homework done in class with teacher help.
why: HN recommends it as an inspiring pitch for video-based, flipped-classroom learning.

quote.text: Watching Khan's TED talk[2] is pretty inspiring.
